top_signals.title: Gold Rises as Traders Weigh Yen Intervention Risk, Fedspeak
top_signals.summary: Gold rose the most in nearly two weeks as the dollar tumbled against the yen and traders reacted to remarks from policymakers on the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Waller Says August CPI Is Key to a Rate Decision
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said his next decision on interest rates will be “heavily influenced” by August inflation data due next week. Waller says if inflation comes in hot, he'd consider a rate hike. Waller said this in remarks prepared for an event hosted by Reuters. Bloomberg's Michael McKee reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: European Stocks Gain as Fed Rate Hike Wagers Ease; Soitec Jumps
top_signals.summary: European stocks gained as traders reduced bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike following remarks from Governor Christopher Waller, while Deutsche Telekom AG gained on news that activist investor Elliott Investment Management has built a sizeable stake.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Read This Before You Buy That TV Streaming Stick
top_signals.summary: Security experts have been sounding the alarm for years about the risks of using generic TV boxes that promise unlimited content streaming for a one-time fee, warning that they secretly rent the user's Internet connection out to strangers. But a groundbreaking new analysis finds these devices also routinely spoof themselves as mobile phones clicking ads on AI-generated websites as part of sprawling operation that seeks to defraud online merchants and advertising networks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
